Protected call.description: Run code without letting an error abort the plugin

grandMA3 conditional command.description: Run a command only if a user variable matches (grandMA3 has no [condition] syntax; GetVar returns a number or a string, as it was stored)

grandMA2 conditional command.description: Run a command only if a variable matches (gma.show.getvar returns text, so compare with a string or use tonumber)

grandMA2 [condition] command.description: A grandMA2 command line that runs only if the condition is true (one comparison: == > < <= >=; numbers compare as numbers, anything else as text)

Yield to the console.description: Hand control back to the console for N seconds

Set a grandMA3 variable.description: Set a grandMA3 variable (a number stays a number; read it in a command as $name)

Read a grandMA3 variable.description: Read a grandMA3 variable (nil when unset; names are case-sensitive)

Set a grandMA2 variable.description: Set a grandMA2 variable (show = global, user = per user); read it with gma.show.getvar / gma.user.getvar, which return text

Test with variables set.description: In a *.test.lua file: set console variables for the function and put them back afterwards
